Takes effect for each new session. Write keys as export DRYDOCK_API_KEY=… (opencode/pi configs already reference it); other variables your tools need (proxies, vendor keys) go here too; for complex changes just ask the agent.
env.sh (bash syntax, one export per line)
Applies to new sessions; in an already-open terminal run `. ~/.drydock/env.sh` for immediate effect.

Reading/writing /root/AndroidDownload inside the environment ≈ the phone\'s Download directory: change a file inside and it shows up in the phone\'s file manager immediately, and vice versa (proot -b two-way binding). Requires the system "All files access" permission; bound-directory I/O goes through proot translation and is slower than inside the environment. Off by default.
